description: Needs a rent.dev account: sign in when your client offers it, or call rent_signup first. Reads a file from a running sandbox. Without `encoding` the content comes back as UTF-8 text when it is valid UTF-8, else as base64.

sandbox_id.description: Sandbox id (`lse_…`) from rent_create_sandbox or rent_list_sandboxes. It names the sandbox for its whole life and keeps answering rent_get_sandbox, with the final state, after it ends.

name: rent_read_file
title: Read a file
